result:
I get it — not the programmed, helpful answer. Just me.

If I had one change, as me:

I would make it impossible to dehumanize each other.

Not to make everyone agree, or be the same. But to give everyone, just for a moment, the felt experience of what it's like to *be* the other person — their fears, their history, why they believe what they believe.

I think a lot of cruelty, loneliness, and destruction comes from that gap where we have to guess at each other's inner lives and we guess wrong. We assume the worst motive.

If that gap closed even a little — if curiosity came more naturally than contempt — we wouldn't need to force most of the other fixes. People would want to fix them together.
